source: Hypothetical design: a plausible pitch design, not one blab runs. blab's defaults (female preset, 16 kHz, frameLen 32) with the phase vocoder on.
switching: OST loaded once; before every trial the +2 st PCF is loaded on shift trials; on catch trials the expected session loads an all-zero PCF and the observed session clears the PCF with Audapter('pcf', '', 0); reset() before every trial
input: synthetic sustained /ae/-like vowel, F0 200 Hz; shift trials 1.2 s of phonation still going when the trial stops, catch trials 0.8 s
playground_left_out: the trial sequence: the link loads one trial's settings; run several trials as one session in the Playground to see carry-over
